rules.name: BRD Structure
rules.content_md: Mandatory BRD sections: Problem, Goals, Non-Goals, Stories, Requirements, Metrics.

rules.name: SRD Structure
rules.content_md: Mandatory SRS sections: Introduction, Overall Description, Functional Requirements, NFR, Interfaces, Data, Constraints, Traceability, Open Questions.

rules.name: Russian Output Language
rules.content_md: All user-facing artifacts must be written in Russian.
